purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Bhuj

queries.query: Bhuj Gujarat official cadastral parcel map land records GIS property map Kutch
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Kachchh district Superintendent Land Records page and City Survey page. They identify the City Survey Superintendent Office, Bhuj and describe property-card/city-survey functions. Gujarat Revenue Department pages identify AnyRoR for rural Records of Rights and e-Milkat for property cards. No anonymous parcel vector service was exposed.

queries.result: Gujarati-language first-party discovery led to the Gujarati-enabled Kachchh district and Gujarat Revenue Department sites, including the same Bhuj City Survey and state land-record service routes. No public anonymous parcel ID+geometry response or safe vector schema was found.

registryEvidence.custodian: City Survey Superintendent Office, Bhuj, under the Superintendent Land Records / District Administration Kachchh, Government of Gujarat.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official district pages explicitly list the Bhuj City Survey Office and its property-card/city-survey functions. This establishes a local registry/cadastre custodian, not public parcel-vector coverage or runtime admission.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID+geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted or used as an absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Kachchh page retrieved. It lists the City Survey Superintendent Office, Bhuj as a subordinate land-record office and gives its Bhuj address/contact. No parcel API or geometry was exposed.

Official Kachchh City Survey page retrieved. It describes property-card copying and survey functions and names City Survey Office Bhuj. No public feature service, schema, CRS, or parcel geometry was exposed.

Official Gujarat Revenue Department route identified through first-party discovery; direct TLS-verified curl timed out after 20 seconds. Its indexed page identifies AnyRoR for rural RoR viewing and e-Milkat for property-card viewing. No unsafe record query was made.

Official Gujarat rural land-record portal route identified. Bounded anonymous fetch timed out; no viewer JavaScript/configuration, public feature endpoint, schema, CRS, native identity, or geometry response was obtained.

Official Gujarat property-card portal route identified from the Revenue Department. Bounded anonymous fetch did not yield a safe parcel geometry response; no login, credentials, private token, or unsafe property query was attempted.

Official state land-record route identified from the Revenue Department / GujMap government-links page. Bounded retrieval did not expose a public parcel vector service or safe anonymous geometry response.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: No parcel query was executed against an exposed feature service; exact WUP point [23.2440402736592, 69.6745939677779] was preserved and not shifted.
boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No usable public feature-query response was obtained.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if publicly exposed and source-proven

scopeLimits: A timeout, login wall, unusable UI, or lack of an exposed feature response is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
